name: Greater Combat Reflexes
body:
You make the most of your attacks of opportunities.

Prerequisites: Dex 15, Combat Reflexes, Improved Combat Reflexes

Benefit: Increase the number of attacks of opportunities you can make each round by 2. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls when making attacks of opportunity.
